observations: Powered indoor TV antenna with two telescoping rod elements and a circular loop element
Black plastic housing with brand text 'PLANET' and 'UHF . VHF . FM TV INDOOR ANTENNA' printed on front
Two small indicator lights (red and green) and a dial/knob near the base
A coaxial (F-type) cable and a separate power cable with a two-pin plug are attached
Visible hairline cracks/scuffs on the plastic housing near the ridged section
Item is sitting on a marble floor, no power source or TV shown to demonstrate function

claims.claim: The old TV indoor Antenna might still be working.
claims.evidence: No power-on test, no indicator light glow, no TV reception shown in photo 0; seller's own wording expresses doubt.

risks.risk: Amplifier/power circuit may be dead (relevant since this is a powered antenna with indicator lights)
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the antenna plugged in with the indicator light lit, or connected to a TV showing a channel scan
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / amplifier dead

risks.risk: Cracks in housing could indicate internal element damage or broken solder joints affecting reception
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cracked areas and the internal circuit board if accessible
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically and possibly functionally damaged

risks.risk: Coaxial cable or power cable could be frayed/damaged internally, not visible in a single static photo
risks.proof: Close-up of cable ends and a continuity/connection test photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as cable condition unknown, worst case needing replacement

proof_requests: Video of the antenna powered on with indicator light lit and connected to a TV showing live channels
Close-up photos of the cracked housing area
Close-up of the coaxial and power cable ends/connectors
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PLANET-branded amplified indoor TV antenna, but the seller's own hedged claim of 'might still be working' is unverified and no functional test is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as non-working with visible cosmetic damage.
